title: Subjunctive in discourse
subtitle: Read exhortation, purpose, and open contingency from context.
overview: The subjunctive appears in shared exhortations, purpose clauses, and open conditions. Its function comes from its construction and discourse setting.
At B1, name the construction before translating: hortatory, purpose, prohibition, or condition.

items.grc: ἀγαπητοί, ἀγαπῶμεν ἀλλήλους, ὅτι ἡ ἀγάπη ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστιν.
items.en: Beloved, let us love one another, because love is from God.

items.grc: ταῦτα λέγω ὑμῖν ἵνα ἡ χαρὰ ὑμῶν ᾖ πλήρης.
items.en: I say these things to you so that your joy may be full.
